highlights.title: Tasks that repeat
highlights.line: Set a task to repeat every hour, day or week from its own page. It says when it last ran and when it runs next.

highlights.title: Token Usage opens in seconds
highlights.line: Token Usage no longer re-reads your whole history each time, so on a long history it opens in seconds, not minutes.

highlights.title: Org charts with a ChatGPT subscription
highlights.line: A picture of your org chart can now be read with a ChatGPT subscription when you build your team.

highlights.title: A cap for Gemini subscription agents
highlights.line: Settings > Automation can limit how many Gemini subscription agents work at once on one Google account.
